core_obligations: Show that [Z/X/S]_r is a relative r-cycle on X/S under flatness of Z over S in dimensions >= r (proof lines 1153-1158). The assumption means O_Z is flat over S in dimensions >= r (proof lines 1154-1155). By lemma-family-associated-module-specialization (tag 0H56) applied with F = (Z -> X)_* O_Z, whose associated family is [Z/X/S]_r by the construction of example-family-associated-closed (tag 0H4S), the family [Z/X/S]_r satisfies the specialization compatibility, i.e., is a relative r-cycle (proof lines 1155-1157).
proof_roadmap: Translate the flatness assumption on Z into flatness of O_Z over S in dimensions >= r (proof lines 1154-1155).
Apply the module-associated specialization lemma to the pushforward of O_Z (proof lines 1155-1157).
